text: That is concerning; newborns do not have a prior exposure history for tuberculosis. speaker: Doctor
text: The chest radiograph showing fine reticular granulation with a ground-glass appearance is highly suggestive of diffuse alveolar damage. Given the newborn's presentation of respiratory distress, grunting, and retractions, this pattern is most consistent with Meconium Aspiration Syndrome or severe Respiratory Distress Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Meconium Aspiration Syndrome
